_doc: Canonical schema constants for the ChangeSet tracker. Source of truth referenced by changeset-common-functions.md §1b. Both kgs-repo scripts/validate_changeset_tracker.py and the dashboards-repo validator import from here. Adding/changing any value requires a ChangeSet with department=operations, platforms=[changeset-process].
_valid_departments_note: cross-functional added 2026-05-04 to legitimize umbrella ChangeSets that span 3+ canonical departments. Use sparingly — if >10% of CSes per quarter use cross-functional, reassess whether finer-grained primary-department + secondary_departments[] is needed.
_field_types_note: Field type enforcement (added 2026-05-04): dependencies, blocks, spawned_changesets, platforms, routed_to (when multiple), sweep_flags MUST be arrays when present. The validator enforces this. Single-value variants (e.g. 'CS-X') must be wrapped in [].
_valid_platforms_note: Platforms describe the SURFACE-OF-CHANGE — the file/URL/API/asset edited (per AP-002). AVOID lazy generics like 'social-media' or 'organic-social'. Use the SPECIFIC platforms the CS actually edits: tiktok-organic, instagram-organic, facebook-organic, linkedin-organic, youtube. Multi-platform CSes list each surface separately. Last expanded 2026-05-04 with auto-optimize (Shopify auto-optimize-orchestrator queue), kenetikpro (KenetikPro practitioner channel), linkedin-organic (LinkedIn organic posting).
_experiment_id_note: experiment_id added 2026-05-05 for CRO experiment ChangeSets originated by the auto-optimize-orchestrator. Format: '<surface>-<NNN>' (e.g., 'pdp-atc-001'). Required when source=='experiment'; null otherwise. The surface is derivable by splitting on the trailing '-NNN'; runtime detail (phase, variant_ratio, metrics, guardrail_checks) lives only in auto-optimize-theme/auto-optimize/state.json under experiments[<surface>]. Single-writer rule: source=='experiment' entries may only be written by commits authored by auto-optimize-orchestrator@drinkkenetik.com (commit-author check enforced in validate_changeset_tracker.py). See changeset-common-functions.md §2 'Experiment-Originated ChangeSets' for full pattern.
_valid_marketing_calendar_statuses_note: Marketing calendar entry status enum. Source of truth for data/marketing-calendar/marketing-calendar-data.json marketing_calendar entries. Read by portal/marketing-calendar-dashboard.html (status dropdown), scripts/validate_marketing_calendar.py, and downstream readers (weekly management email filter, D13 brief).
_valid_content_calendar_statuses_note: Content calendar entry status enum. Source of truth for data/marketing-calendar/marketing-calendar-data.json content_calendar entries. Read by portal/marketing-calendar-dashboard.html and downstream readers.
_valid_team_tasks_statuses_note: Status enum for data/tasks/team-tasks.json entries. Added 2026-05-19 with PR 1.B. Simpler than marketing calendar — no needs_SOW, approved, or planning-specific values.
_valid_team_tasks_tracks_note: Track enum classifies a team-task by its destination workflow. Execution = direct campaign support; system_improvement = ChangeSet candidate; idea = parking lot; governance = process/standards work. Added 2026-05-19 with PR 1.B per locked-designs.md decision 2.
_valid_team_tasks_sources_note: Source enum records where a team-task came from (separate from track which is destination). Added 2026-05-19 with PR 1.B per locked-designs.md decision 2.
_valid_owning_departments_note: 7 KGS departments. Used as the primary owning_department field on marketing_calendar, content_calendar, team_tasks, and retail_channels entries. Multi-department entries carry an optional contributing_departments array (array of values from the same enum). Added 2026-05-19 with PR 1.B per locked-designs.md decisions 5 and 6.
_valid_retail_channel_stages_note: 7-value lifecycle for a retail channel relationship. pipeline = BD discussions, onboarding = signed and prepping, pos_setup = launch week prep, active = selling, review = performance evaluation, expansion = scaling additional doors, sunset = winding down. Added 2026-05-19 with PR 1.C.
_valid_retail_channel_types_note: Channel-type discriminator on retail-channels.json entries. Added 2026-05-19 with PR 1.C. Future expansion of wholesale-specific account-handling may justify splitting wholesale to its own file.
_valid_marketing_calendar_categories_not: 6 top-level categories that replace the 65 legacy types on marketing_calendar entries. Added 2026-05-19 with PR 1.D per locked-designs.md decision 1. Each entry preserves its original type as `legacy_type` so downstream consumers can query finer granularity when needed. Attributes (anchor_creator, anchor_athlete, partner_org, linked_retail_channel_id, linked_product_launch_id, sub_beats) carry the variation that legacy types used to encode.
_marketing_calendar_subbeat_templates_no: Per-category default sub-beat templates. The system suggests these when a new parent campaign is created; Katie can override any per campaign. After 90 days of observed usage we look at the override rate and decide whether to codify per-category enums. Added 2026-05-19 with PR 1.D per locked-designs.md decision 3.
_lifecycle_extension_note: 2026-05-06: Lifecycle build plan v5 Amendment 5. New optional fields added: klaviyo_object, lock_in_time, confidence_tier, pattern_id, klaviyo_campaign_id, klaviyo_flow_id, klaviyo_message_id, klaviyo_segment_id, activation_date, pre_refresh_baseline, design_status, last_figma_pull_timestamp, figma_feedback_available, shared_hypothesis_id, pair_id. New enums: valid_klaviyo_objects, valid_confidence_tiers, valid_design_statuses. New platform: shopify-notification (Recharge customer-facing notifications via Klaviyo + Shopify customer-facing notifications now in CS framework per v8 §1.9).
_canonical_metrics_note: Canonical metric IDs from brain/kenetik-brain/references/metrics-registry.yaml. Sync via: python3 -c 'import yaml,json; m=yaml.safe_load(open("brain/kenetik-brain/references/metrics-registry.yaml"))["metrics"]; sc=json.load(open("kenetik-growth-system/commands/_schema-constants.json")); sc["canonical_metrics"]=sorted(m.keys()); json.dump(sc, open("kenetik-growth-system/commands/_schema-constants.json","w"), indent=2)'. Run on any registry change. Used by build_cs_entry.py to validate expected_impact.metrics_moved entries.
